# NEW 2026-11-21 v10.5 Worker 3: Nova Elysia Three Religious Paths, Western Pantheon & Pyrophoroi/Copper-Clad Military (oe_eln_, 0 slots). Generated by gen_elysia_faith_military.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# CRITICAL EU5 1.4.9 GOD-ENGINE SAFETY:
# EU5 1.4.9 ignores gods/*.txt potential and grants ALL hellenism_religion gods on conversion.
# Immediately removes both Nova Elysia New World deities unless explicitly seated on this country.
oe_eln_purge_unseated_gods = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_seated_sol_hesperius }
			any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_eln_sol_hesperius_god }
		}
		remove_god = god:oe_eln_sol_hesperius_god
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_seated_oceanus_neptune }
			any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_eln_oceanus_neptune_god }
		}
		remove_god = god:oe_eln_oceanus_neptune_god
	}
}

# Defense-in-depth <= 6 gods cap guard (2 ADM + 2 DIP + 2 MIL):
# If an external v9.8 oe_romp swap added a 3rd ADM or DIP god while a New World god was seated,
# cleanly yield the New World deity so the active pantheon never exceeds 6 gods.
oe_eln_enforce_six_god_cap = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = oe_eln_seated_sol_hesperius
			any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_eln_sol_hesperius_god }
			calc_true_if = {
				amount >= 3
				any_current_gods = { this = god:zeus_god }
				any_current_gods = { this = god:aphrodite_god }
				any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_sol_invictus_god }
				any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_juno_god }
				any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_vesta_god }
				any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_asclepius_god }
				any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_eln_sol_hesperius_god }
			}
		}
		remove_god = god:oe_eln_sol_hesperius_god
		remove_variable = oe_eln_seated_sol_hesperius
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = oe_eln_seated_oceanus_neptune
			any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_eln_oceanus_neptune_god }
			calc_true_if = {
				amount >= 3
				any_current_gods = { this = god:poseidon_god }
				any_current_gods = { this = god:hermes_god }
				any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_janus_god }
				any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_apollo_god }
				any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_isis_serapis_god }
				any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_eln_oceanus_neptune_god }
			}
		}
		remove_god = god:oe_eln_oceanus_neptune_god
		remove_variable = oe_eln_seated_oceanus_neptune
	}
}

# Seat Sol Invictus Hesperius (ADM pillar), displacing 1 active ADM deity first to guarantee <= 2 ADM / <= 6 total.
oe_eln_seat_sol_hesperius = {
	oe_romp_ensure_omens_unlocked = yes
	oe_romp_purge_unseated_gods = yes
	oe_eln_purge_unseated_gods = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_seated_sol_hesperius } }
		if = {
			limit = { any_current_gods = { this = god:aphrodite_god } }
			remove_god = god:aphrodite_god
			set_variable = oe_romp_unseated_aphrodite
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_sol_invictus_god } }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_sol_invictus_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_sol_invictus
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm2_sol_invictus }
				remove_variable = oe_romp_adm2_sol_invictus
				remove_variable = oe_romp_adm2_custom
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm1_sol_invictus }
				remove_variable = oe_romp_adm1_sol_invictus
				remove_variable = oe_romp_adm1_custom
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_juno_god } }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_juno_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_juno
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm2_juno }
				remove_variable = oe_romp_adm2_juno
				remove_variable = oe_romp_adm2_custom
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm1_juno }
				remove_variable = oe_romp_adm1_juno
				remove_variable = oe_romp_adm1_custom
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_vesta_god } }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_vesta_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_vesta
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm2_vesta }
				remove_variable = oe_romp_adm2_vesta
				remove_variable = oe_romp_adm2_custom
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm1_vesta }
				remove_variable = oe_romp_adm1_vesta
				remove_variable = oe_romp_adm1_custom
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_asclepius_god } }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_asclepius_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_asclepius
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm2_asclepius }
				remove_variable = oe_romp_adm2_asclepius
				remove_variable = oe_romp_adm2_custom
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm1_asclepius }
				remove_variable = oe_romp_adm1_asclepius
				remove_variable = oe_romp_adm1_custom
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_current_gods = { this = god:zeus_god } }
			remove_god = god:zeus_god
			set_variable = oe_romp_unseated_zeus
		}
		set_variable = oe_eln_seated_sol_hesperius
		add_god = god:oe_eln_sol_hesperius_god
		oe_eln_enforce_six_god_cap = yes
	}
}

# Unseat Sol Invictus Hesperius and restore the matching vacated vanilla ADM deity (keeps strictly 2 ADM gods).
oe_eln_unseat_sol_hesperius = {
	oe_romp_ensure_omens_unlocked = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_variable = oe_eln_seated_sol_hesperius
				any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_eln_sol_hesperius_god }
			}
		}
		remove_god = god:oe_eln_sol_hesperius_god
		remove_variable = oe_eln_seated_sol_hesperius
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_adm2_custom }
				NOT = { any_current_gods = { this = god:aphrodite_god } }
			}
			remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_aphrodite
			add_god = god:aphrodite_god
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { any_current_gods = { this = god:zeus_god } }
			}
			remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_zeus
			add_god = god:zeus_god
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { any_current_gods = { this = god:aphrodite_god } }
			}
			remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_aphrodite
			add_god = god:aphrodite_god
		}
	}
}

# Seat Oceanus-Neptune (DIP pillar), displacing 1 active DIP deity first to guarantee <= 2 DIP / <= 6 total.
oe_eln_seat_oceanus_neptune = {
	oe_romp_ensure_omens_unlocked = yes
	oe_romp_purge_unseated_gods = yes
	oe_eln_purge_unseated_gods = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_seated_oceanus_neptune } }
		if = {
			limit = { any_current_gods = { this = god:hermes_god } }
			remove_god = god:hermes_god
			set_variable = oe_romp_unseated_hermes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_janus_god } }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_janus_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_janus
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip2_janus }
				remove_variable = oe_romp_dip2_janus
				remove_variable = oe_romp_dip2_custom
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip1_janus }
				remove_variable = oe_romp_dip1_janus
				remove_variable = oe_romp_dip1_custom
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_apollo_god } }
			remove_god = god:oe_romp_apollo_god
			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_apollo
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip2_apollo }
				remove_variable = oe_romp_dip2_apollo
				remove_variable = oe_romp_dip2_custom
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip1_apollo }
				remove_variable = oe_romp_dip1_apollo
				remove_variable = oe_romp_dip1_custom
			}

			limit = { any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_romp_isis_serapis_god } }

			remove_variable = oe_romp_seated_isis_serapis

				remove_variable = oe_romp_dip2_isis_serapis
				remove_variable = oe_romp_dip2_custom
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip1_isis_serapis }
				remove_variable = oe_romp_dip1_isis_serapis
				remove_variable = oe_romp_dip1_custom
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { any_current_gods = { this = god:poseidon_god } }
			remove_god = god:poseidon_god
			set_variable = oe_romp_unseated_poseidon
		}
		set_variable = oe_eln_seated_oceanus_neptune
		add_god = god:oe_eln_oceanus_neptune_god
		oe_eln_enforce_six_god_cap = yes
	}
}

# Unseat Oceanus-Neptune and restore the matching vacated vanilla DIP deity (keeps strictly 2 DIP gods).
oe_eln_unseat_oceanus_neptune = {
	oe_romp_ensure_omens_unlocked = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				has_variable = oe_eln_seated_oceanus_neptune
				any_current_gods = { this = god:oe_eln_oceanus_neptune_god }
			}
		}
		remove_god = god:oe_eln_oceanus_neptune_god
		remove_variable = oe_eln_seated_oceanus_neptune
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_dip2_custom }
				NOT = { any_current_gods = { this = god:hermes_god } }
			}
			remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_hermes
			add_god = god:hermes_god
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { any_current_gods = { this = god:poseidon_god } }
			}
			remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_poseidon
			add_god = god:poseidon_god
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { any_current_gods = { this = god:hermes_god } }
			}
			remove_variable = oe_romp_unseated_hermes
			add_god = god:hermes_god
		}
	}
}

# Cleanly unseat both Western Pantheon deities before entering v9.8 Capitoline Hexapantheon swapper.
oe_eln_reset_western_gods = {
	oe_eln_unseat_sol_hesperius = yes
	oe_eln_unseat_oceanus_neptune = yes
	oe_romp_purge_unseated_gods = yes
	oe_eln_purge_unseated_gods = yes
}

# Seamlessly establish or join v9.8 Collegium Pontificum IO (oe_romp_pontificate).
oe_eln_join_or_create_pontificate = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { unique_international_organization_type_exists = international_organization_type:oe_romp_pontificate } }
		create_international_organization = {
			type = international_organization_type:oe_romp_pontificate
			add_country_to_international_organization = root
			set_leader_country = root
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization_of_type = { type = oe_romp_pontificate } } }
		international_organization:oe_romp_pontificate ?= {
			add_country_to_international_organization = root
		}
	}
}

# Safe Path B conversion to Religio Romana (hellenism_religion) with immediate 6-god purge & IO integration.
oe_eln_convert_to_religio_romana = {
	religion:hellenism_religion = {
		enable_religion = yes
		set_variable = { name = hellenism_has_omens value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { religion ?= religion:hellenism_religion } }
		set_variable = oe_romp_ev4_fired
		change_religion = religion:hellenism_religion
		hidden_effect = {
			oe_romp_purge_unseated_gods = yes
			oe_eln_purge_unseated_gods = yes
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_style_grecoroman }
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_romp_style_roman }
				}
				set_variable = oe_romp_style_roman
			}
		}
		ruler_or_regent ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { religious_figure ?= religious_figure:cardinal } }
				change_character_religion = religion:hellenism_religion
			}
			every_descendant = {
				limit = {
					is_alive = yes
					owner = root
					NOT = { religious_figure ?= religious_figure:cardinal }
				}
				change_character_religion = religion:hellenism_religion
			}
		}
		heir ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { religious_figure ?= religious_figure:cardinal } }
				change_character_religion = religion:hellenism_religion
			}
		}
		consort ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { religious_figure ?= religious_figure:cardinal } }
				change_character_religion = religion:hellenism_religion
			}
		}
		capital = {
			spawn_movement = {
				movement_definition = movement_definition:hellenism_religion_movement
				supporters = {
					value = population
					multiply = 0.15
				}
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		hidden_effect = {
			oe_romp_purge_unseated_gods = yes
			oe_eln_purge_unseated_gods = yes
		}
	}
	oe_eln_join_or_create_pontificate = yes
}

# O(1) Semiannual Act II Faith & Military Event Dispatcher (months 5 & 11; at most 1 event per tick).
oe_eln_faith_mil_dispatch = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_semiannual_ticks } }
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_semiannual_ticks value = 1 }
	}
	else = {
		change_variable = { name = oe_eln_semiannual_ticks add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_eln_faith_path }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_faith_path_ticks } }
			set_variable = { name = oe_eln_faith_path_ticks value = 1 }
		}
		else = {
			change_variable = { name = oe_eln_faith_path_ticks add = 1 }
		}
	}

	# 1. Core Three Religious Paths Fork (oe_eln.3, ~4 years post-settlement)
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev3_fired }
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_faith_path }
			has_variable = oe_eln_semiannual_ticks
			var:oe_eln_semiannual_ticks >= 8
		}
		set_variable = oe_eln_ev3_fired
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.3
	}
	# 2. Path A: Western Ecumenical Patriarchate (oe_eln.4 -> oe_eln.5)
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_eln_is_path_orthodox = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev4_fired }
			has_variable = oe_eln_faith_path_ticks
			var:oe_eln_faith_path_ticks >= 4
		}
		set_variable = oe_eln_ev4_fired
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_eln_is_path_orthodox = yes
			has_variable = oe_eln_ev4_fired
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev5_fired }
			has_variable = oe_eln_faith_path_ticks
			var:oe_eln_faith_path_ticks >= 16
		}
		set_variable = oe_eln_ev5_fired
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.5
	}
	# 3. Path B: Nova Elysia Religio Romana & v9.8 Western Pantheon (oe_eln.6 -> oe_eln.7 -> oe_eln.8)
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_eln_is_path_religio_romana = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev6_fired }
			has_variable = oe_eln_faith_path_ticks
			var:oe_eln_faith_path_ticks >= 2
		}
		set_variable = oe_eln_ev6_fired
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_eln_is_path_religio_romana = yes
			has_variable = oe_eln_ev6_fired
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev7_fired }
			has_variable = oe_eln_faith_path_ticks
			var:oe_eln_faith_path_ticks >= 6
		}
		set_variable = oe_eln_ev7_fired
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_eln_is_path_religio_romana = yes
			has_variable = oe_eln_ev7_fired
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev8_fired }
			has_variable = oe_eln_faith_path_ticks
			var:oe_eln_faith_path_ticks >= 12
		}
		set_variable = oe_eln_ev8_fired
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.8
	}
	# 4. Path C: Atlantic Edict of Symmachus (oe_eln.9)
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			oe_eln_is_path_symmachus = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev9_fired }
			has_variable = oe_eln_faith_path_ticks
			var:oe_eln_faith_path_ticks >= 6
		}
		set_variable = oe_eln_ev9_fired
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.9
	}
	# 5. Military Line: Chalybopolis Arsenal & Pyrophoroi Musketeers (oe_eln.10)
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev10_fired }
			has_variable = oe_eln_semiannual_ticks
			OR = {
				AND = {
					var:oe_eln_semiannual_ticks >= 14
					oe_eln_has_iron_foundry_base = yes
				}
				var:oe_eln_semiannual_ticks >= 20
			}
		}
		set_variable = oe_eln_ev10_fired
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.10
	}
	# 6. Naval Line: Chesapeake Copper-Clad Galleon Launch (oe_eln.11)
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_eln_ev11_fired }
			has_variable = oe_eln_semiannual_ticks
			var:oe_eln_semiannual_ticks >= 18
			oe_eln_has_copper_shipyard_base = yes
		}
		set_variable = oe_eln_ev11_fired
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_eln.11
	}
}
